tools.name: search
tools.description: Search published English hotel guides. Returns document IDs and canonical source URLs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a known document ID or exact canonical URL returned by search. No arbitrary URLs are fetched.

tools.name: find_hotels
tools.description: Find published hotel records by exact destination name/slug, optional text and category. No live availability or price filters.

tools.name: compare_hotels
tools.description: Compare 2–5 known hotel IDs using sourced published fields. No inferred winner or comparable live prices.

tools.name: get_destination_guide
tools.description: Find published guide documents for a known destination. Fetch returned IDs for full source text.

tools.name: get_booking_links
tools.description: Return exact published affiliate and official URLs with disclosure. Does not visit links or book rooms.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
